content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I help our customers by getting to know them, by taking time to understand their goals and finding solutions to help them meet those goals today and in the future. 

A Little About Me

I joined the Bank in 2017 as a Regional Sales and Service Manager with over 30 years of retail banking experience. I was later promoted to Member Experience Market Manager and Vice President.

I am a 2019 graduate of Furman University’s School of Retail Bank Management and a graduate of the Greater Norwich Area Chamber of Commerce L.E.A.D. Program. I completed the New England Leadership Development Program in 2019.

I am actively involved in the community, serving as a board member at The Riverfront Children’s Center. I serve on their finance and their HR committees. I participate in the Relay for Life every year and volunteer for the Alzheimer’s Association.

I am a proud 2018 Forte Award recipient. What I like most about working at CGB is our commitment to our communities in which we live and work.

I reside in Norwich, CT.
